Agar hava men piem 2.5, piem 10, graund leval ozon, naitrojan daeeoksaid aur salfar daeeoksaid hai.
Yani kul milakar hamare aaspas pradushit hava hai aur ekyuaaee ka leval behad khatarnak star par pahuncha huaa hai.
Aise men agar ham en95 mask pahante hain to kya yah kargar sabit hoga.
Kya N95 ya N99 mask ko pahankar ham pradushit hava men sans le sakte hain.
Kya N95 mask behad kharab AQI men bhi kargar sabit hota hai aur ye kab phel ho jata hai?
In savalon ke javab janne ki koshish karenge is vidiyo ke zarie.
